name: Hoverboard

abilities.name: Hover
abilities.effect: A hoverboard maintains an altitude of 6 inches above other surfaces, such as the ground or water. If driven off a high surface, the hoverboard loses 20 feet of altitude per round, landing without harm to the hoverboard or its pilot.

abilities.name: Portable
abilities.effect: The hoverboard can be carried as an item with 1 Bulk.

space: 4 feet long, 1 foot wide, 6 inches high

name: Enercycle

abilities.name: Portable
abilities.effect: The enercycle can be pulled along the ground on its wheel by a Medium creature. The creature is encumbered.

space: 10 feet long, 5 feet wide, 3 feet high

name: Explorer Buggy

abilities.name: All-Terrain
abilities.effect: An explorer buggy hovers six inches above surfaces, such as the ground or water. If driven off a high surface, the explorer buggy loses 20 feet of altitude per round, landing without harm to the explorer buggy or its pilot.

abilities.name: Middle Seat
abilities.effect: A Small creature can fit in the backseat of an explorer buggy that already has 3 passengers.

abilities.name: Turret
abilities.effect: This explorer buggy is armed with a commercial reaction breacher which can be fired by any passenger.

space: 10 feet long, 10 feet wide, 7 feet high

name: Forklift

abilities.name: Heavy Load
abilities.effect: A forklift carries its cargo on its front forks and can carry up to 1,000 Bulk.

abilities.name: Lift
abilities.effect: The pilot raises the forklift's forks up to 15 feet in the air, or lowers the forklift's forks down to the ground.

space: 10 feet long, 5 feet wide, 7 feet high

name: Motor Boat
space: 15 feet long, 5 feet wide, 4 feet high

name: Turboglider

abilities.name: Cruising Drop
abilities.effect: The only way to use the wind propulsion of a turboglider is to jump off a steep incline or if you're already in the air. An uncontrolled turboglider using wind propulsion falls 60 feet each round until the pilot successfully Takes Control. A turboglider must be controlled to switch propulsion. If the glider hits the ground before the pilot successfully Takes Control, the pilot and the glider each take falling damage.

space: 4 feet long, 10 feet wide, 1 foot high

name: Skyboat

abilities.name: Harness the Storm
abilities.requirements: The skyboat is in a rainstorm
abilities.effect: The skyboat harnesses the storm's electrical energy through its magical sails, then expels this energy as a bolt of lightning that erupts from the front of the skyboat. The lightning deals 2d8 electricity damage to each creature in a 60-foot line (DC 18 basic Reflex save). Harness the Storm stops working if the skyboat is broken.

space: 15 feet long, 10 feet wide, 3 feet high

name: Torpedo Minisub

abilities.name: Submersible
abilities.effect: The torpedo minisub can travel beneath the surface of the water, carrying an air reservoir suitable to sustain 2 Medium creatures for up to 24 hours. The torpedo minisub can safely reach depths of up to 1 mile. If broken, the torpedo minisub loses air from its reservoir, reducing the stored air by 10 minutes per round. A broken torpedo minisub has its maximum depth reduced by half (and rises to that depth when broken, if necessary).

space: 10 feet long, 5 feet wide, 3 feet high

name: Drop Pod

abilities.name: Controlled Plummet
abilities.effect: This vehicle is programmed to deploy from another airborne vehicle or spaceship and fall toward the ground at a rate of 500 feet the first round and 1,500 feet each round thereafter, for a world with normal gravity. One round before impact, antigrav rotors, parachutes, and retrorockets slow the descent to 60 feet per round, allowing for a safe landing (even if uncontrolled).

abilities.name: Enclosed
abilities.effect: The pilot and passengers of a drop pod are completely enclosed and don't have line of sight or line of effect with any creatures or objects outside the vehicle.

abilities.name: Space Vehicle
abilities.effect: This vehicle protects its users from the dangers of space, including the benefits of basic environmental protection and a commercial filtered rebreather.

space: 12 feet long, 12 feet wide, 15 feet high

name: Urban Cruiser

abilities.name: Middle Seat
abilities.effect: A Small creature can fit in the backseat of an urban cruiser that already has 3 passengers.

space: 10 feet long, 10 feet wide, 4 feet high

name: Enercopter
space: 20 feet long, 10 feet wide, 12 feet high

name: Patrol Dirigible

abilities.name: Drifter
abilities.effect: The patrol dirigible can only be steered using its motorized propulsion, otherwise relying on favorable wind currents to carry it in the right direction. If the pilot fails to maintain control of the dirigible using its wind propulsion, the dirigible drifts whichever way the wind carries it, moving up to four times its Speed each round as determined by the GM.

abilities.name: Hangar Bay
abilities.effect: The patrol dirigible provides a place for up to two Huge or smaller vehicles to be docked.

space: 80 feet long, 60 feet wide, 40 feet high

name: Wakeskimmer

abilities.name: Sea-to-Sky Transference
abilities.effect: The pilot engages transference mode, causing the wakeskimmer to launch itself from a body of water (or other fluid) up into orbit or to plummet from space into the sea, at a Speed of 1,500 feet per round.

abilities.name: Space Vehicle
abilities.effect: This vehicle protects its users from the dangers of space, including the benefits of basic environmental protection and a commercial filtered rebreather.

space: 15 feet long, 6 feet wide, 6 feet high
speedText: fly 60 feet (motorized; space only) or swim 40 feet (motorized)
